subject: pe

items.q: Does training have to be painful to work ('no pain, no gain')?
items.correct: No — progressive overload drives improvement, and rest is essential.
items.misconception: Yes, training only works if it hurts.
items.random_wrong: Rest days make you less fit.
items.why: Adaptation comes from gradually increasing demands and allowing recovery, not from pain.

items.q: Are all components of fitness the same thing?
items.correct: No — strength, speed, stamina, flexibility and others are distinct.
items.misconception: Yes, fitness is a single quality.
items.random_wrong: Strength training and cardiovascular fitness are identical.
items.why: Different training methods develop different components of fitness.
